name: Ansel Watrous Campground
evidence: Esri 0.22 m/px with 30 m bars: Poudre 17-23 m upper, 16-26 m lower, under the ~30 m rule. Pads 4/5/6 ~26-30 m, 15/16/17 ~24-25 m through thin riparian fringe, no road between. Site photos show no water; no rec.gov water tag. Tent 14 and walk-ins 8-10 not counted.

name: Mountain Park Campground
evidence: Esri/NAIP frames with bars: Poudre ~15-29 m, under the rule. Electric sites 1-32 ~60 m+ from bank, fence beyond 011/013, photos 001-032 show no water. West FCFS loop pads ~22-36 m behind a continuous conifer band; those sites have no catalog entry or photos, so no view proven.

name: Stove Prairie Campground
evidence: Esri 0.20 m/px bars: channel 18-30 m around the bend, median ~24 m, under the rule. RV sites 007/008/009 ~22-26 m from W channel, 002 ~26 m, 001 ~28 m from E channel, thin fringe, no road between. Photos show no water. Sites 003-006 walk-in tent, not counted.

name: Dutch George Campground
evidence: Bars: Esri high flow 26-30 m (rapids ~29-34), NAIP lower flow 19-28 m, under the rule at the sites. Spur ends ~14-21 m from water, only a foot trail and scattered brush between. FS page: flat in riparian zone, spurs 30-70 ft, FCFS. No per-site map or photos found.

name: Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area (Hecla Junction)
evidence: Esri bars: river 19-31 m, median ~21 m, under the rule. Pads ~23-36 m from water on boulder terraces; EPQS pad 2258 m vs water 2248 m within ~22 m, so a bench climb-down. cpwshop tags 1103/04/06/07/09-12 Riverfront, lead only; site 1112 photos show the river below, others mostly trees.

name: Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area (Rincon)
evidence: Esri 0.26 m/px bars: 27, 31, 25 plus side channel (36 total), 32 m, ~30 m at the sites. cpwshop tags all 8 sites 1201-1208 Riverfront, spurs 24-75 ft; site photos show open water right behind tables. Pads ~11-20 m from water, thin shrub fringe, no road between.

name: Gates of Lodore Campground
evidence: Green River 130 m+ wide (frame 2317_w, 30 m bar), far over the rule. rec.gov tags all 19 FCFS sites Riverfront, fits 25-ft RV. Frame 2317_z1: W sites 11-19 pads ~34-42 m to water across open sand and scattered shrub, tables closer. Photos show no water. E-side sites across the road not counted.

name: Blue River Campground
evidence: Bars: Esri 26-30 m, NAIP autumn 21-25 m, creek by size. Sites 014 and 016 ~10-11 m from water, photos show river behind the table; 012/018 through trees. But rec.gov driveways there are 10-20 ft (imagery suggests ~15-20 m spurs, unresolved) and only 009 lists 23 ft+, ~75 m off with no water. Fit not proven, held at riverview.
